fdroid:com.myAllVideoBrowser.name: SuperX Video Downloader
fdroid:com.myAllVideoBrowser.summary: Video downloader with browser for downloading videos from everywhere
fdroid:com.myAllVideoBrowser.description:
SuperX is a powerful and private video downloader for Android, built with freedom and flexibility in mind. It allows you to save videos from a wide variety of websites and platforms directly to your device for offline viewing. As a fully open-source application, it contains no trackers, no advertisements, and all processing is done locally on your device to protect your privacy.
 Core Features: 
* Wide Compatibility: Download videos from many websites and social media platforms.
* Advanced Stream Support: Fully supports modern streaming protocols, including HLS (.m3u8) and DASH (.mpd) manifests, as well as standard MP4 streams and live broadcasts.
* Standard Format: All downloaded videos are saved in the universal .mp4 container for maximum compatibility with any player.
* Client-Side Processing: All operations happen on your device. No data is sent to external servers, ensuring your activity remains private.
 Advanced Privacy & Networking: 
* Cookie Support: Allows you to use your browser's cookies to access and download videos from private or login-protected areas.
* Full Proxy Integration: Enhance your privacy and bypass network restrictions with built-in support for HTTP and SOCKS proxies.
* Proxy Chaining & DNS Security: For ultimate privacy, the app supports proxy chains and can be configured with encrypted DNS (DoH/DoT) and custom servers.
SuperX is the ideal tool for users who demand control over their media and their privacy. By providing direct access to download streams and robust networking tools, it ensures a free and open way to access online video content.

* Price Change - Triggered when price changes more than X amount (in currency or percentage)

fetched with a given update interval (e.g. 30 s) and compared with the price
fetched one time frame ago (e.g. 15 min ago).

and configuration. The alarm list behaves as your ticker, where you can reorder
your alarms and directly change their limits. Triggered alarms ring, displaying
their status, until you turn them off. Just like an alarm clock. Alarms can also
be set to snooze automatically on price retrace. Market data is retrieved
directly from the exchanges via Wi-Fi or Mobile Data (if allowed).
Boilr supports all available on libdynticker , as all their pairs.
For a version history check the GitHub
releases page .

gnome-extensions:clipboard-history@manou.name: Clipboard History
gnome-extensions:clipboard-history@manou.summary:
Clipboard access: this extension reads the system clipboard every time its contents change, and records what it reads in a history stored locally under ~/.cache/clipboard-history@manouchehr/. Nothing is sent over the network, and clipboard data is never shared with any third party. Content marked as sensitive by password managers such as KeePassXC, Bitwarden and KWallet is not recorded.
A Windows-style clipboard history panel for GNOME Shell. Open it from the panel icon, or assign a keyboard shortcut of your own in the extension preferences — no shortcut is set by default. Super+V is the binding this panel is modelled on; note that GNOME assigns it to the message tray out of the box, so you would need to free it there first.
Features:
• Keeps a scrollable history of everything you copy — text, links, and images
• Image entries show inline thumbnail previews
• Pin frequently used entries so they are never evicted from history
• Search your text history as you type
• Auto-paste: pick an entry and it is inserted straight into the focused application
• Emoji, Kaomoji, and Symbols tabs for inserting characters that are awkward to type
• Full RTL support — Persian and Arabic text renders and aligns correctly
• Configurable history size, and one-click clearing of the current tab that keeps pinned entries

firefox-addons:1468584.name: Augmented Steam
firefox-addons:1468584.description:
Augmented Steam is a browser extension by IsThereAnyDeal that improves your experience on the Steam platform by providing helpful information and tons of customization options.
Some selected features:
- Price details (current best, historical low) for any game or DLC sourced from many authorized stores
- More visible highlighting of games you own or have wishlisted or ignored (also works with your IsThereAnyDeal Waitlist and Collection!)

- Custom profile backgrounds and styles, visible to all users of Augmented Steam
- Take and store notes about any game
- Maximize information relevance by hiding unwanted content blocks from app pages or the homepage
- Automatically skip age gates for NSFW content
- Batch actions for various scenarios, e.g. registering multiple product keys or adding multiple DLCs to your cart at once
- And many more!
Augmented Steam is a fork and spiritual successor of Enhanced Steam, which has come to its end of life in February 2019.

firefox-addons:2290895.name: Go To Playing Tab
firefox-addons:2290895.description:

apple-macos:6797433952.name: The Heavens Weather App
apple-macos:6797433952.description:
The Heavens reads the weather against your day: your plans, your body, your pets and your home, in plain words.
YOUR DAY
• Your Day: your first plan of the day with the weather at its hour. Pro checks all your plans, and when rain will reach an outdoor one, it names the nearest indoor places.
• Pro: the best hour to get outside for a walk, a run, a ride or a hike, where available.
• Tonight: whether to open a window, from the overnight air and the bedroom temperature you like.
• Pro: weather along your route, mile by mile, timed to when you will be there.
YOUR HEALTH
• Sun: your sun budget for the day, for your skin type.
• Heat: how the heat should change your pace outdoors.
• Allergies: pollen and what is blooming near you, where they're measured. Pro tells you when your pollen is up, even with the app closed.
• Air quality: the reading, what is driving it, and the day's peak.
• Mosquitoes: tonight's odds and local health reports, where published.
• On iPhone, log how you feel in Apple Health and see whether it lines up with changes in air pressure.
Wellness estimates, not medical advice.
YOUR DOG, YOUR PLANTS, YOUR COMMUTE (PRO)
• Walk windows built on your dog's breed and how it handles heat.
• Frost advice from what your plants can take.
• Your commute, read against the weather at the hour you leave.
SAFETY, FREE ON EVERY PLAN
• Severe weather warnings are never behind a paywall.
• In the U.S., tornado, flash flood, tsunami, snow squall and extreme wind warnings can sound even on silent, if you allow it.
• Where the app cannot receive official warnings, it says so instead of showing an all-clear.
• Lightning alerts when a strike is close to you, where available, if you turn them on.
• Ask Air how close the nearest lightning is, free.
• Apple Watch checks U.S. warnings on its own when your iPhone is out of reach.
THE HEAVENS BROADCAST
A short spoken broadcast for your area, over the live radar. Everyone gets a new one each day; Pro and Ultra make new ones through the day. Pro and Ultra also end each one with a short part for you: your plans, your dog or plants, and your allergies.
ASK AIR, YOUR AI METEOROLOGIST
Ask in plain words. Air looks up live conditions, forecasts and warnings before it answers. One conversation a day for everyone; Pro gives you more, and Air remembers what you tell it.
RADAR AND STORMS
• Live radar on a loop, in the U.S., Canada and much of the world.
• Tropical storms worldwide, with official forecast tracks.
• Pro: lightning distance, count and trend, and U.S. severe outlooks with tornado and hail risk.
• Ultra: a live 3D view inside the storm over the contiguous U.S.
WEATHER WHERE YOU AREN'T (ULTRA)
Ultra watches up to 10 of your saved places with the app closed and alerts you when severe weather reaches one. It also follows your flight live.
EVERY SCREEN
iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV and Vision Pro, each built for its own screen. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, and with Pro, a widget for any of your places.
PRIVACY
No ads, no tracking. Your Apple Health records stay on your device; if you turn on health context, a short summary written on the device goes with your forecast request. Usage data is anonymous, with no identifier and no location, and you can turn it off in Settings.
PLANS
The Free plan costs nothing, and official warnings are on every plan. Pro and Ultra are monthly or annual subscriptions, charged to your Apple Account. They renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage them in your Apple Account settings.
